author: Chris Varney
title: IGHSAU Girls Basketball Rankings - NewsBreak
text:
By Chris Varney ,
1 hours ago (Area) — The Iowa Girls High School Athletic Union has released its new girls basketball rankings.
Atlantic has fallen four spots from #10 to #14 after a 1-2 start to the season. One of those losses came to St. Albert who is still #1 in Class 1A. Exira EHK lost their opener to Riverside and fell two spots from #6 to #8 in Class 1A. Coon Rapids Bayard also fell in the 1A poll from #11 to #14.
In Class 2A, Treynor stays at #2, AC/GC stays at #8 and Riverside remains at #14.
Carroll entered the 3A poll at #15.
